entities.summary: Georges Kahhalé Zouhaïraty, BA is a prelate of the Melkite Catholic Church and served as Apostolic Exarch for the Melkite Greek Catholic Apostolic Exarchate of Venezuela, from 1995 until his retirement c. 2019.
